title: Main review policy live semantic source parity repair

phases.objective: Repair live review-policy source parity so the immutable Migration 1051 source remains exact-blob pinned while the shared capability-envelope runtime is compared through the repository-policy-specific semantic contract, preventing unrelated capability additions from blocking readiness without weakening repository-policy safety gates.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The live policy activation contract test runs on the exact PR candidate.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The runner pins Migration 1051 to its exact Production Git blob and proves that the repository-policy-specific capability-envelope constants, policy builder functions, authority binding call, and first short-circuit behavior are semantically identical between current main and Production before readiness can succeed.
steps: Read the live activation runner, policy target contract, and repository-policy envelope source-contract helper.
Verify Migration 1051 remains pinned to its exact Production Git blob SHA.
Read capability-resolution-envelope-create.mjs from exact current main and exact Production.

Extract only the repository-policy capability constants, repository policy request/surface/builder functions, repository authority builder call, and first short-circuit behavior into a deterministic semantic contract.
Require exact semantic-contract fingerprint parity between current main and Production; unrelated capability additions outside that contract do not change the fingerprint.
Validate the exact controller plan after readback and before readiness success.

Fail closed when the repository-policy semantic contract drifts, the operation is blocked, activation blockers are present or unreadable, any plan precondition is not true, the plan SHA is not the exact target, or the plan reports mutation.
Revalidate the same executable-plan gate in Apply before consuming the readiness marker or creating, approving, or authorizing an envelope.
Run environment-impact closure and governance closure on the exact candidate.
Keep readiness read-only and leave Branch Protection, Rulesets, database, migration, provider, and Production effects disabled.
assertions: Migration 1051 remains exact-blob pinned to a705b4425c962b65efae3f92a7e9ef20706e0841.
Repository-policy source parity is derived only from the exact repository-policy constants and functions plus the repositoryPolicyDryRun authority-builder call and first short-circuit ordering.
Adding an unrelated capability path outside the repository-policy semantic contract does not change its fingerprint.
Changing the repository-policy operation intent or builder behavior changes the semantic fingerprint and blocks readiness.
Current main and Production must expose the same repository-policy semantic fingerprint before readiness can proceed.

ready_for_apply is impossible unless plan.operation is create_ruleset or update_ruleset, activation_blockers is a readable empty array, every plan precondition is true, the expected plan SHA matches the exact target SHA, and mutation_executed is false.
Apply rechecks the executable plan before readiness-marker consumption and before any capability envelope creation or authorization.
A blocked plan produces fail-closed diagnostic evidence and grants no Apply authority.
Environment impact is explicitly declared for staging and production.
Live staging certification remains required and production mutation remains false.
No Branch Protection or Rulesets Apply, migration, grant, SQL/DB mutation, provider mutation, credential payload read, force-push, or Production activation occurs.
